summary: Quick regression after Emergent-dependency removal. All 5 targeted checks PASS: admin login (cookie-based), /api/auth/me, local-disk fallback storage upload+download roundtrip for both POST /api/upload and POST /api/auth/upload-doc, GET /api/payments/config returns {enabled:false}, and frontend /login -> admin dashboard flow with Google button rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: storage.py local fallback writes under backend/storage_data which is ephemeral in container; for self-deploy, document mounting a persistent volume or configure S3 vars.
Google OAuth client ID origin for the preview URL is not whitelisted - GSI_LOGGER prints 'origin not allowed'. Email/password login unaffected; just FYI for prod domain whitelist.
seed_data_creation: None (uploads create files under storage_data/binaralms/uploads/admin_root/*.png - small, safe to leave).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is COOKIE-based (access_token, refresh_token httpOnly SameSite=None Secure). Use requests.Session() for pytest - do NOT expect a JSON token in /api/auth/login response. For file downloads, GET /api/files/{path} also requires auth cookie. Local disk fallback is active (no S3 env set); files at /app/backend/storage_data. Midtrans not configured - /api/payments/config returns enabled:false (expected).
